ios.desc:
Top Now is the app you want when browsing YC's Hacker News via Safari is not enough, Top Now offers a familiar and enhanced navigation of the Hacker News web experience:

- Every article opens in a temporary browsing session.
- Delivers optional push notifications on every new top #1 article on the home page.
- HN discussions are available right after you finish reading articles.


Everything else works as expected, including your regular user sign-in, upvotes, flagging, comments and other sections of the Hacker News web experience.
